title: LLMEval-Fair: A Large-Scale Longitudinal Study on Robust and Fair Evaluation of Large Language Models
reasoning: The LLMEval-Fair benchmark evaluates models across 13 primary academic disciplines, one of which is 'Philosophical Sciences'. As shown in Figure 6 and Table 6, this category specifically includes 'Religious Studies' and 'Ethics' as sub-categories, with a substantial set of over 10,000 questions dedicated to this subject area.
